result_text:
The change is in place in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`, in `getAllTeams()`.

The remainder ("Undefined Team") now only takes an unmatched contributor when `contributor.getContributor().isActive()` is true. I added that condition to the existing `if (!added[0] && ...)` check, so configured teams are untouched and dormant unmatched contributors are skipped.

- **Blank dates:** `Contributor.isActive()` delegates to `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange`, which returns true for a blank latest-commit date. So contributors with missing dates still land in the remainder.
- **Tests:** `mvn -q -o -pl codeanalyzer test -Dtest='*Landscape*,*Contributor*'` ran with no output, so no failures were reported. No existing test covers `LandscapeAnalysisResults` or `TeamsConfig`, so this change is not exercised by a test. I did not add one.
- **Not committed.**
